snippet.title: STARVAULT | Open Beta Launch Trailer | Meta Quest
snippet.description:
STARVAULT – the first full-scale VR MOBA on Meta Quest.
Choose your hero. Squad up. Push lanes. Farm creeps. Clear jungle camps. Battle for the Titan. And dominate the map in intense 5v5 team fights.
Classic MOBA with stunning visuals that push the Meta Quest to its absolute limits.

PLAY FO FREE in Open Beta on Meta Quest 2, 3, 3s. Link in BIO. 
#starvault #starvaultvr #vr #metaquest3
